result.summary: Found 1 issue: a visual inconsistency in the restaurant image display.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card shows a placeholder image with what appears to be a loading state or missing image, while all other restaurant cards display actual food images. This creates visual inconsistency in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder image with an actual food image for Green Bowl Poké, or ensure the placeholder style matches the other restaurant cards for visual consistency.
